name: LTD Championship
epitaph: Crowned in an eight-man tournament at LTD's own first show, New Blood Rising, where Bob Yobbo Jr. beat Barabbas, Scott Royal and Myrddin across a single night. Venom took it from Yobbo between shows and held it through Winter's Wrath before Myrddin — billed under the aka Robert Tical — won it back, presumed at the uncaptured Steel City Carnage PPV. Myrddin was still champion, and still defending it in a six-man that also carried the tag titles, when the surviving record runs out.

name: LTD Progressive Championship
epitaph: First attested already held by Headbuster as of LTD's own December 2001 front page, and defended clean through Winter's Wrath. Headbuster lost it to Scott Royal at an uncaptured show sometime before 19 March 2002, and Royal was still champion — and still defending it, in a three-way against Humpy and Poltergeist that both men earned by eliminator wins the same night — when the surviving record runs out.

name: LTD Lethal Championship
epitaph: First attested already held by Barabbas as of the 19 March 2002 Progression show, where he retained it against Sloan Malice inside a Hardcore Steel Cage. Still champion, against an opponent the surviving record never names, when it runs out.

name: LTD Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Contested in a tournament seeded at Winter's Wrath from eight teams; the final is never captured, and HaVoC (billed Ruthless Inc. once Maxx Vain joined) are the first attested champions, holding the belts into 19 March 2002. Baine and Parker Louis, wrestling as Global Warning, won them off Ruthless Inc. that night in the same six-man that kept Myrddin's LTD Championship, and were still champions — billed back down to a two-man HaVoC challenge for Genesis — when the surviving record runs out.
